description: 放課後の高校の音楽室で、3人の生徒が文化祭に向けてバンド練習をしている。中央では男子生徒がアコースティックギターを弾きながら楽譜を確認している。左側の女子生徒は電子キーボードを演奏し、譜面台に置かれた楽譜を見ながら音を合わせている。右側の女子生徒はマイクの前で歌いながら、片手でリズムを取っている。周囲にはギターケース、譜面台、メトロノーム、アンプ、楽譜、音楽ポスターなどがあり、3人が互いの音を聞きながら文化祭の発表に向けて練習している。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three teenage students practicing music together in a bright modern Japanese high school music room after school. Do not include any additional visible people. The atmosphere should be energetic, focused, creative, cooperative, and positive. The main activity is band practice for an upcoming school festival. In the center foreground, a teenage boy wearing a school uniform with his jacket removed is sitting or standing with an acoustic guitar. He is strumming the guitar while glancing at a music sheet placed on a nearby music stand. His fingers should clearly be positioned on the guitar neck as if forming chords. On the left side, a teenage girl wearing a school uniform is playing an electronic keyboard. She is looking at sheet music on a music stand and appears to be carefully matching the rhythm and melody with the guitarist. On the right side, another teenage girl is standing in front of a microphone on a stand. She is singing while lightly keeping the beat with one hand and looking toward the other two students. Make the three activities visually distinct and easy to describe: one student playing guitar, one playing keyboard, and one singing into a microphone. Include a guitar case, electronic keyboard, microphone stand, sheet music, music stands, metronome, small amplifier, cables arranged safely, a stool, notebook, pencils, wall clock, simple music posters, acoustic panels, and large windows with warm late-afternoon sunlight. A small whiteboard in the background may show simple musical notes and a rehearsal schedule using nonessential text, but the image must be understandable without reading it. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The three students are rehearsing a song for the school festival.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒は文化祭に向けて曲を練習しています。

sentences.text: The boy is strumming an acoustic guitar while following the sheet music.
sentences.ja: 男子生徒は楽譜を見ながらアコースティックギターを弾いています。

sentences.text: The girl at the keyboard is carefully playing the melody.
sentences.ja: キーボードの女子生徒は注意深くメロディーを弾いています。

sentences.text: She appears to be listening to the guitarist so that they can stay together.
sentences.ja: 彼女は演奏を合わせるためにギターの音を聞いているようです。

sentences.text: The other girl is singing into a microphone.
sentences.ja: もう一人の女子生徒はマイクに向かって歌っています。

sentences.text: She is keeping the rhythm with one hand while singing.
sentences.ja: 彼女は歌いながら片手でリズムを取っています。

sentences.text: The instruments and music stands suggest that they are having a serious rehearsal.
sentences.ja: 楽器や譜面台から、3人が本格的な練習をしていることが分かります。

sentences.text: The students seem focused on improving their performance.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは演奏をより良くすることに集中しているようです。

熱心に取り組んでいる

安定したテンポを保つ

sentences.text: The three students are participating in an ensemble rehearsal in preparation for a live performance at the school festival.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒は文化祭でのライブ演奏に備えてアンサンブル練習をしています。

sentences.text: The guitarist is strumming a sequence of chords while consulting the sheet music positioned beside him.
sentences.grammar: while＋現在分詞 / 過去分詞修飾
sentences.ja: ギター担当の生徒は、そばに置かれた楽譜を確認しながらコード進行を演奏しています。

sentences.text: His concentration suggests that he is attempting to maintain a steady tempo and synchronize with the keyboard.
sentences.ja: 彼の集中した様子から、安定したテンポを保ちながらキーボードと演奏を合わせようとしていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The keyboard player is carefully interpreting the arrangement while listening closely to the guitarist.
sentences.ja: キーボード担当の生徒はギターの音を注意深く聞きながら、楽曲の構成を表現しています。

sentences.text: Her role appears to involve supporting both the melody and the overall harmony of the ensemble.
sentences.grammar: appear to / both A and B
sentences.ja: 彼女の役割は、メロディーとアンサンブル全体のハーモニーの両方を支えることのようです。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the vocalist is singing into the microphone and using subtle hand movements to maintain the rhythm.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形 / to不定詞
sentences.ja: その一方で、ボーカル担当はマイクに向かって歌いながら、細かな手の動きでリズムを取っています。

sentences.text: She appears highly engaged as she responds to the musical cues provided by the other performers.
sentences.ja: 彼女は他の演奏者からの音楽的な合図に反応しながら、非常に熱心に取り組んでいるようです。

sentences.text: The metronome, sheet music, and carefully arranged equipment indicate that the students are approaching the rehearsal in a methodical manner.
sentences.ja: メトロノーム、楽譜、整えられた機材から、生徒たちが手順立てて練習に取り組んでいることが分かります。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how a successful musical performance depends on individual skill, attentive listening, and close coordination among performers.
sentences.ja: この場面は、よい音楽演奏には個人の技術、注意深く聞くこと、演奏者同士の密接な連携が必要であることを示しています。
